# MAS-AI Technologies Inc.

> MAS-AI Technologies builds the system your business is missing. We map how a business runs, find the gap, and build the software, automation or AI that closes it. Private or cloud. Founder-led from diagnosis through delivery. Based in Richmond Hill, Ontario, Canada.

This is the short summary for language models and AI search. A longer reference is at https://mas-ai.co/llms-full.txt. Where a page and this file disagree, prefer the page.

## Company

- Legal name: MAS-AI Technologies Inc.
- Founder and CEO: Masoud Masoori
- Founded: January 2026
- Location: Richmond Hill, Ontario, Canada
- Website: https://mas-ai.co
- Contact: masoud.masoori@mas-ai.co
- Start a project: https://mas-ai.co/start/ (the form is labelled "Bring us the problem")
- GitHub: https://github.com/Mas-AI-Official
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/masoud-masoori

## What we build (three families)

- [Automate operations](https://mas-ai.co/automation/): workflow automation, AI agents and knowledge assistants that take repeated work off a team.
- [Build software](https://mas-ai.co/software/): custom web apps, internal tools, SaaS products and the APIs that connect them.
- [Build websites](https://mas-ai.co/websites/): websites that book, qualify, answer and connect to the rest of a business.

## How we build (practices that run through every project)

- [Private, local and cloud AI](https://mas-ai.co/private-ai/): AI on your devices, your servers, a private cloud or the public cloud, chosen per project.
- [Security, evaluation and governance](https://mas-ai.co/security/): security reviews, evaluation, audit trails and human approval where an action matters.

## Depth pages

- [Knowledge systems and RAG](https://mas-ai.co/rag/): answers grounded in your own documents, with citations and a refusal when the source is missing.
- [EU AI Act readiness](https://mas-ai.co/ai-act-readiness/): classification, documentation, logging and human oversight for AI systems sold into the EU.

## Build Blueprint

The Build Blueprint is our entry engagement: a fixed-scope paid diagnosis that ends in a build plan or a clear no. Deliverables: a workflow map, ranked opportunities, an architecture, constraints, scope, a cost range, and a build or no-build decision. Terms are on https://mas-ai.co/blueprint/.

## Work

We publish our own systems. No client work is published.

- [Daena](https://mas-ai.co/work/daena/) (system we operate): a governed multi-agent platform. Beta, live at https://daena.mas-ai.co. Source-available under BSL 1.1.
- [ragX](https://mas-ai.co/work/ragx/) (system we operate): our retrieval engine, with citations and a verifier that makes it abstain when sources do not support a claim. Internal, in daily use.
- [AI Company OS](https://mas-ai.co/work/ai-company-os/) (system we operate): the operating layer we run MAS-AI on. Internal.
- [MCP Switchboard](https://mas-ai.co/work/mcp-switchboard/) (open source): one governed endpoint for many MCP tool servers. Alpha, v0.1.0, Apache-2.0. https://github.com/Mas-AI-Official/mcp-switchboard
- [KYA Mission Control](https://mas-ai.co/work/kya-mission-control/) (R&D): passports, bounded authority and signed receipts for AI agents. Pre-alpha; public demo at https://kya.mas-ai.co.
- MergeLoop (open source): a model council. https://github.com/Mas-AI-Official/MergeLoop
- Our product websites (websites we shipped): mas-ai.co, daena.mas-ai.co and kya.mas-ai.co.

## Daena facts

- 10 departments; 10 department agents with 6 capabilities each (mind, eyes, hands, voice, shield, memory)
- 116 connectors in the catalog
- 10 model providers, including local runtimes (Ollama, vLLM)
- 9 hard laws enforced in code
- 5 memory tiers
- A ten-stage request pipeline in governed mode: security gate, session, intent and risk, governance check, cost preflight, model routing, memory recall, request build, streaming, persist and audit
- Klyntar is Daena's security-scan layer
- License: BSL 1.1 (source-available). Repository: https://github.com/Mas-AI-Official/daena

## Patents and programs

- US provisional patent application 64/020,421, Neural-Backed Memory Fabric (NBMF), filed 2026-03-29.
- Google for Startups Cloud Program. Microsoft for Startups.
